summary: Phase 10D AI Tools frontend + RBAC tested end-to-end. All 7 requested scenarios PASSED. Super admin login shows 'AI Tools' menu, /ai-tools renders ai-tools-page with 3 tabs (Permission Matrix, Tool Test, Audit Log). Matrix lists 27 tools; toggling GET_FAQ switch persists across reload (PUT /api/ai/tools/GET_FAQ succeeded). Playground SEARCH_PACKAGE with {q:''} returns OK + results list. issues: Recharts warnings about width(-1)/height(-1) on multiple charts — harmless dev warnings, unrelated to Phase 10D but noisy in console

critical_code_review_comments: AITools.jsx is a single 193-line file with 3 sub-tab components — acceptable size, well-structured, uses data-testid consistently.

Guard at line 169 (Navigate to /dashboard for non-super_admin) works, but actual observed behavior shows a 403 Forbidden page — likely from a global route guard (ProtectedRoute using ROUTE_PERMS). Both mechanisms redundantly protect the route; verify no duplicate/conflicting redirects.
Playground presets do not include HIGH_RISK tools like REFUND — running with empty {} still correctly creates approval request; fine but consider adding presets for high-risk tools too for better UX.
